content:
Noah (Growth): Idea: add a tiny "refer a teammate" CTA to the benchmark launch nurture to drive inbound MQLs. Keep registrant drip 3 emails; referral variant adds an extra micro-email after confirm.
Eve (Lifecycle): Proposed flows: Registrant core = confirm, 48h highlight, 1hr before. Referral arm (segment): confirm + immediate tiny ask to "share with a teammate" (one-click), then standard reminders. Clickers rescue = 2-step finish-signup.
Rae (Content): I'll write 2-line referral copy: subject "Share this benchmark with a teammate" preview "One click to invite" and a 1-sentence why ("help them ship faster"). Also short alt CTAs: "Invite a colleague" / "Share insights".
Jon (Design): Will add a compact inline CTA (secondary) that opens a lightweight modal and attaches referral tag. Mobile-first, non-intrusive. Provide icons + dark/light variants.
Priya (Analytics): UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark_referral_v1&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Track: referral clicks, referral-submits, RSVP-by-referral, downstream trial starts from referral. KPIs: referral click 2-4%, referral->lead conversion 10%. Seed 30 internal for QA.
Noah (Growth): Routing: when referral_click -> webhook /hooks/referral with payload lead_id + ref_email. Auto-tag ref_source=email_referral. If a ref signs, route to AE queue for high-value accounts.
Eve (Lifecycle): Owners: Noah (lead), Rae (copy), Jon (creative), Priya (metrics). Can we get assets + test sends by Wednesday?
campaign-bot: Ticket MK-7001 created for referral CTA + microflow. https://app.redwood/boards/MK-7001 :white_check_mark:
Rae (Content): Posting draft copy now; will include variation for Dedicated customers.
Priya (Analytics): :thumbsup: I'll wire tracking and dashboard once HTML is ready.
